title: Dubai
tagline: Where the desert meets the future
description: Dubai does nothing by halves. Watch the city glitter from the 148th floor of the Burj Khalifa, then trade skyscrapers for silence on a dune drive into the Arabian desert, ending with a barbecue under the stars.

Between the headline sights there's a softer Dubai too — abra rides across the Creek, the spice and gold souks of Deira, and the elegant calm of Abu Dhabi's Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. With direct flights from most Indian cities and visas handled by us, it's the easiest big-trip escape there is.
